style: Style: classic MU Online (Webzen) fantasy MMORPG interface - dark burnished bronze and antique gold filigree metal, deep red gemstones, gothic angular shapes, rich painterly game-UI rendering, crisp clean edges, orthographic flat front view, no text, no letters, no watermark.

icons_menu.prompt: A row of exactly 4 separate square game menu ICONS, evenly spaced in a single horizontal row with clear empty gaps between them, each icon same size inside its own round bronze-gold medallion frame with dark interior: 1) a glowing golden sword pointing up (continue/resume), 2) an ornate bronze gear cog (settings), 3) a knight helmet (character select), 4) a glowing blue magic portal/globe (server select).

icons_exit_display.prompt: A row of exactly 4 separate square game menu ICONS, evenly spaced in a single horizontal row with clear empty gaps between them, each icon same size inside its own round bronze-gold medallion frame with dark interior: 1) a red glowing open gothic door (exit game), 2) a magic crystal mirror/screen with blue glow (display), 3) a faceted multicolor gemstone with sparkle (graphics quality), 4) a golden radiant sun (lighting).

icons_settings.prompt: A row of exactly 4 separate square game menu ICONS, evenly spaced in a single horizontal row with clear empty gaps between them, each icon same size inside its own round bronze-gold medallion frame with dark interior: 1) a golden war horn with sound waves (audio), 2) an unrolled parchment scroll (interface), 3) an hourglass with glowing blue sand and lightning (performance), 4) a magnifying lens over a glowing purple rune (debug/advanced).
